component.name: Grimoire Linux
component.summary: A black & white toolkit for KDE Plasma 6

description.p: Grimoire Linux is one app with a set of black & white desktop tools ("spells") for KDE Plasma 6 on Wayland:

ul.li: MuraL: customize wallpaper playlists and video wallpapers, lock screen, splash, login, boot, taskbar, colors, icons, fonts and cursor, with a community store
SightsL: a click-through crosshair overlay above every window and fullscreen game
VaultL: a file manager that keeps Downloads tidy, with undo and a real Trash
OptimizeL: speed tweaks as on/off switches that survive restarts and turn back off cleanly
SystemL: a system monitor with live graphs, processes, per-app history, services and alerts
TerminalL, ShotL, FocusL and NetL: a terminal, screenshots and recording, a focus timer and a network monitor

description.p: No telemetry: it only goes online when you ask it to, or to check GitHub for updates.
